description: This file defines an interface 'SuffixBuilderConfig' and an enumeration 'SuffixBuilderConfigValue' that provides configuration settings for a MongoDB suffix builder component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods to retrieve supported prefixes and enumerates default configuration values.

classes.name: SuffixBuilderConfig
classes.description: An immutable interface defining methods related to MongoDB suffix builder configuration.

classes.name: SuffixBuilderConfig.SuffixBuilderConfigValue
classes.description: An enum listing known configuration values and default settings for the suffix builder.

methods.name: getSupportedPrefixes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported prefix strings for MongoDB collection name suffixes.
